subject: Free jollof party in Abuja, Tuesday
headline: {name}, there's jollof on Tuesday
body: You joined LinkUpNaija but haven't been to a link-up yet, so here's an easy first one. The AITF LinkUp Jollof Party is free, it's at the Trade Fair complex on Airport Road, and nobody has to approve you: tap Join and you're in. Twelve people already are. Dance battle, rap battle, jollof eating challenge, and a giveaway at the end.
